reviews.title: Help train LLMs and see AI pics
reviews.text:
In about  a week of use, I spent over $300 on this app.  During that time I only contacted people with verified photos, because the ones that weren’t verified are either very clearly AI or incredibly fuzzy photos that look like they were taken in 2010 with a camera phone.  I spent the money because I had a response rate of about 25%, which is pretty good for a middle aged man.  

But, in talking to the other people, 75% stated they had the US as their location country but they actually lived in another country and had never been to the US.  The other 25 percent I believe are AI and large language model programs learning to communicate, based on their insistence of being in the US but displaying the following: 
1) always being where I live if I give my location first
2) confusing US geography - telling me they live in the Seattle area of Washington Dc
3) using non-American english (“it is Friday and I was quite Bored so I coloured”
4) multiple users using the same message templates - seriously how many women have to start a conversation with “hello handsome”  before I get suspicious?

Of over 50 conversations in the last 7 days, I only identified 3 people I am convinced were real: 1 in Honduras whose profile said US, 1 person offering to sell content, and 1 woman in her late 50s that was incredibly rude.

Bottom line -
Don’t download unless you want to help support the development of large language models both financially and in their use of American english, or you just like
